Place \(C=(0,0)\), \(A=(4,0)\), \(B=(0,3)\). The incenter is \((1,1)\), and the touchpoints are
\[
(1,0),\quad (0,1),\quad \left(\frac85,\frac95\right).
\]
The area of this contact triangle is
\[
\frac12\left| \det\begin{pmatrix}-1&1\\ \frac35&\frac95\end{pmatrix}\right|
=\frac12\left|-\frac{12}{5}\right|=\frac65.
\]
Since \([ABC]=6\), the required ratio is
\[
\frac{6}{6/5}=5.
\]
\[
\boxed{5}
\]
